Stallion Group — website colour directions

Four options for the group site, shown on the same layout, photography and typography so only the colour changes. Every element below is from the live build. Reply with a preference and we set it across all eighteen pages in a few minutes.

Charcoal

Near-black and gold. The most premium and timeless of the three — the register Trafigura and Vitol use. Recedes behind the photography and never dates.
